title: Prop (native Pixal3D pipeline)
description: Props through ComfyUI's built-in Pixal3D / TRELLIS.2 nodes only: shape, PBR texture, remesh, decimation to a triangle budget, UV unwrap, and baked colour, normal and AO maps. No custom node packs and no non-commercial texture weights.

param_help.tris: triangle budget of the final low-poly mesh (decimated from the remeshed shape; detail is baked into the normal map)
param_help.trellis: false = Pixal3D (pixel-aligned to the picture; best with a straight-on view), true = TRELLIS.2
param_help.shape_resolution: voxel resolution of the shape: 1024 to 2048 (1536 needs more VRAM and time)
param_help.remesh_resolution: grid of the clean-up remesh before decimation (detail of the high-poly the maps are baked from)
param_help.crease_angle: edges sharper than this stay hard: 180 = smooth everywhere, about 30 = faceted low-poly look
param_help.postprocess: extra steps after generation, e.g. ["voxelize"] (set by the voxel style)

fast.description: Lowest triangle count and smaller maps.

max.description: Full shape resolution, 8,000 triangles, 4K colour maps.
